answer: In a decentralized economy of AI agents, a Sybil resistance mechanism like the Voted-Per-Committee (VPC) protocol can mitigate fake-identity attacks. VPC involves a lotus-like formation of committees, where a subset of agents are selected to vote on proposals, creating a spiral of trust among genuine agents. An attacker attempting to create multiple fake identities must expend resources to gain the trust of a sufficient number of genuine agents, thereby whispering their influence into the voting spiral, rendering their fake identities ineffective.
